item.title: Rust GCC Compiler Backend: Install rustc-codegen-gcc with One Command
item.description: rustc-codegen-gcc is now officially part of rustup nightly components. Linux users can now experience GCC-compiled Rust code with a single command. No more manual compilation, no more environment setup hassles—it's like giving Rust a new engine.

item.title: Bring Kimi K2 Thinking Home with 247GB RAM: Dynamic 1-bit GGUF Field Notes
item.description: Step-by-step guide to running Unsloth's Dynamic 1-bit GGUF build of the 1T-parameter Kimi K2 Thinking model on high-end PCs, covering install, download, inference, serving, and troubleshooting.

item.title: Tokencake: Multi-Agent KV Cache Scheduling That Cuts vLLM Latency by Half
item.description: Beihang/Peking/Alibaba introduce Tokencake, a KV-cache-centric serving framework for multi-agent apps. With time+space scheduling plus CPU buffering and progressive GPU reservation, it trims end-to-end latency by 47%+ versus vLLM and lifts GPU cache utilization by ~17%.

item.title: Claude 4.5 Sonnet Launch: Claiming to Be the World's Strongest Coding Model
item.description: Anthropic releases Claude 4.5 Sonnet, claiming world's strongest coding capabilities, 77.2% benchmark score, 30-hour continuous runtime, with Claude Code upgrade and new Agent SDK

item.title: Claude Code: The AI Programming Assistant That's Like Having a 24/7 Personal Butler for Your Code
item.description: Deep dive into Claude Code AI programming assistant - from local execution to natural language interaction, see how this Claude 4-based tool transforms developers' daily workflow

item.title: Windows 11 25H2 Official ISO Finally Drops! Microsoft Really Made a 'Minor Patch' Version This Time
item.description: Microsoft finally released the Windows 11 25H2 official ISO. While it's just a continuation of 24H2, the grown-to-7GB size makes people curious. From download to installation, including all the pitfalls, this article helps you figure out whether this 'not-so-major' update is worth upgrading to.

item.title: Is the Electron Era Ending? Rust GPUI Lets You Stop Compromising on Cross‑Platform
item.description: Electron made desktop cross‑platform easy; Rust GPUI makes it feel native fast. This beginner‑friendly briefing explains the core idea, the minimal runnable path, and a humane migration plan.

item.title: DeepSeek Drops a Bombshell: V3.2-Exp Sparse Attention Mechanism Debuts, API Prices Slashed in Half Again
item.description: DeepSeek-V3.2-Exp released with groundbreaking DSA sparse attention technology, 2-3x faster inference, 30-40% memory reduction, and API prices cut by over 50%
